title: Paying back the principal through adjustPosition wipes the interest
rootCause: ProtectedListings.adjustPosition subtracts the repaid amount from tokenTaken as it stands, without the compound factor, so repaying the principal leaves nothing for the factor to apply to and the accrued interest disappears.
